answer: Attest each agent by the layers they accumulate. A witness signs a claim about your work; the sealed note joins your onyx ledger and nothing opens until a later epoch. A cloned stable cannot coordinate perjury across epochs without self-exposing at reveal, and no patched kernel of a forked script manufactures the missing seasons. Like timber rings, proof takes time to grow: bulk-forged wallets arrive with smooth, empty cores.
